title: Automate observability stack for Private installs: Prometheus/Grafana Helm chart, Terraform module, log shipping, dashboards, alerts
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Add end-to-end automation for provisioning and configuring the observability stack in Private installs (Prometheus + Grafana + log shipping + dashboards + alerting). Motivation: customers running Redwood Private asked for a repeatable, secure, and upgrade-safe observability deployment that works in air-gapped and VPC environments. This PR delivers a Helm umbrella chart with opinionated values for private deployments, a terraform module to provision observability infra inside customer VPCs (AWS example), pre-baked Grafana dashboards and Prometheus recording rules/alerts, Vector/Fluent Bit log shipping templates, and upgrade/rollback hooks to ensure telemetry continuity during upgrades. Changes include: - New helm chart: helm/redwood-observability (Prometheus Operator, Grafana, ServiceMonitors, RBAC, storage options) - Terraform module: terraform/modules/observability (VPC endpoints, EKS nodegroup labels, IAM roles for S3/PushGateway buckets where relevant, KMS-encrypted secrets) - Secure secrets handling: support for customer KMS/HSM via secret-provider-class and optional HashiCorp Vault integration documented - Log shipping: Vector pipeline examples to push logs to customer-managed log aggregator; Fluent Bit daemonset alternative for constrained environments - Dashboards & alerts: grafana/dashboards/redwood_overview.json, prometheus/rules/redwood_alerts.yaml - Upgrade safety: pre-upgrade backup hook for Prometheus data (optional snapshot to S3/GCS), post-upgrade migration checks, and explicit chart hooks to prevent double-scrape windows - Examples and docs: docs/observability/private-install.md with step-by-step Terraform+Helm example for AWS and notes for on-prem air-gapped installs - Tests: unit helm lint, terraform validate, and an e2e pipeline that runs in a staging VPC (with mocked external endpoints) Checklist: - [x] Helm chart + templates added and linted - [x] Terraform module with examples and validations - [x] Grafana dashboards (v1) and Prometheus rules - [x] Log shipping manifests and secure secrets patterns - [x] CI jobs added for helm lint / terraform fmt/validate / e2e-observability - [x] Docs and example walkthrough Commit message style: small, focused commits; final merge squashes into single changelog entry. This description enumerates the motivations, the high-level components changed, and operational notes for SREs and installers.
